## Updates for February 2025

**🎤 Voice, Audio & File Nodes**
- New nodes for voice, audio, and file capture are now available, offering enhanced media and engaging interactions.

**📁 Capture Update**
- Added support for file and separate entity capture type, giving you more flexibility in handling inputs.

**🔍 AI Retrieval Node**
- The AI Retrieval node helps your AI find and use the right information from stored data in real time.

**📚 Confluence Training Source**
- New confluence training source is now available for enhanced learning.

**🏷️ Training Tags**
- Segment your knowledgebase training with new training tags.

**💬 AI Response Tags**
- In Studio AI knowledgebase responses now support tags for improved accuracy.

**🤖 New AI Model: Claude Sonnet 3.7**
- Introducing Claude Sonnet 3.7 for advanced AI capabilities.

**🛠️ Studio Improvements**
- Enjoy a smoother workflow with the latest studio improvements.

**📅 New Events**
- Events now include marked resolve and a (Post knowledgebase).

**🔗 Web-hook**
- Integrate and automate with the new web-hook feature.

## Updates for January 2025

**🦾 JSON Mode in AI Response**
- Generate structured AI responses using the AI Task within Studio, streamlining bot development.

**❓ AI-Powered FAQ Generation**
- Automatically generate FAQs using AI for faster, more accurate responses to common queries.

**🎨 Enhanced UI & UX for Smoother Workflows**
- Improved user interface for a more intuitive and seamless building experience.

**⏳ Wait Node for Better Flow Control**
- Add delays and improve conversation flow with the new Wait Node in Studio.

**🎛️ Dynamic Choices on Interactive Elements**
- Supports card buttons, carousels, and regular buttons for a more dynamic and engaging experience.

**💡 AI-Enhanced Helpdesk Writing**
- Enhanced AI writing features with multiple writing styles for clearer, more professional articles.

**📚 Advanced Helpdesk Training Controls**
- Exclude specific data from AI training and train the View Source for greater control over AI learning.

**📱 Mobile App Enhancements**
- Improved general performance for a faster, smoother app experience.

**📝 New Forms Elements (Studio)**
- Collect user input easily with the new Forms Node in Studio, enhancing chatbot interactivity.

**🔐 SOC 2 Type 2 Compliance**
- YourGPT is now fully compliant with SOC 2 Type 2, ensuring top-tier security and data protection.

## Updates for December 2024

**💬 Helpdesk in Tab Chatbot Widget**
- Access Your Helpdesk directly from chatbot, use tab widget to enable.

**🔒 Custom Roles for AI Chatbot**
- Admins can now create and assign custom roles for managing AI chatbot functionalities.

**👥 Organisation Invite & Roles**
- Streamlined organization-level invites with role-based access to better manage teams.

**🏢 Organisation-Level Access Settings**
- Added new access settings at the organization level for better control over data and permissions.

**🔔 Notification Center**
- A centralized notification center to track important updates and system alerts.

**🛠️ Template Functions**
- Added support for template functions in base prompts, studio, automated response for customization and flexibility.

**🤖 Generate Prompt with AI**
- Users can now generate custom bot persona (base prompt & restrictions) using AI assistance to improve the creation process.

**🚫 Block Contact**
- Added a feature to block specific contacts from interacting with your chatbot.

**📄 AI Response JSON Creation**
- Generate AI response outputs in JSON format for seamless API integration.

**🔍 Widget SDK Visitor Identification**
- We’ve added a new identity verification feature that securely authenticates users before they can interact with the chatbot.

**🖊️ Helpdesk Robust AI Writing**
- The Helpdesk AI writing feature now supports different formatting styles to meet varied use cases.

**🔄 AI Helpdesk Custom Rewrite**
- Introduced the ability to rewrite Helpdesk content using custom prompts for tailored responses.

**📊 AI Helpdesk Analytics**
- A new analytics dashboard to track and improve Helpdesk AI performance.

## Updates for November 2024

**🏋️‍♂️ Trainer Role**
- You can now assign a Trainer Role to manage and improve chatbot responses.

**🔗 New Integrations**
- Zapier: Automate workflows and connect your apps effortlessly.
- Pabbly: Make your processes more efficient with automation.
- Make (formerly Integromat): Build custom integrations for advanced workflows.
- Twilio WhatsApp: Twilio WhatsApp integration lets you connect with users directly through the chatbot on WhatsApp.

**📚 Training Improvements**
- Enhancement in Advanced Training options for better bot training capabilities.
- Use past conversations from YourGPT Chatbot to create a training job for your AI chatbot to improve over time.

## Updates for October 2024

**👥 Team Chat Features**
- Assign or reassign chats to distribute workload efficiently among team members.
- Multi-operator support for handling simultaneous conversations.
- Internal notes feature to facilitate private team communication within chats.
- Chat translation capabilities for messages in preferred languages.

**📚 Helpdesk Improvements**
- AI-powered article generation for automatic creation of helpdesk content.

**🧪 Debug Lab Enhancements**
- Introduction of a new chat logger to track and analyze AI Bot interactions.

## Updates for September 2024

**✨AI Helpdesk Feature Rollout:**
- **Capabilities:**
- Multilingual search for diverse user queries.
- AI-powered responses for quick answers.
- Rich content training support with unlimited content integration.

**🔧 Studio Improvements:**
- Quick addition of nodes/steps with the Quick Add button.
- Enhanced import and configuration processes within the studio.
- Variable highlighting and selection in text nodes for better usability.

**🌐 Widget Custom Domain Setup**
- Simplified setup process for chatbot widget custom domains.

**📲 Twilio Integration**
- AI-powered SMS and voice support now available with Twilio.

**📄 Documentation Update**
- We've improved The documentation to guide you through all the recent features and improvements.

## Updates for August 2024

**🧪Debug Lab**
- Users can check and adjust chatbot training data directly for improved performance.

**📝 Website to FAQs**
- Automatically generate FAQs from website content to aid both AI and human understanding.

**📊 LLM Leaderboard**
- Compare performance benchmarks of LLM models with our leaderboard tool.

**🔍 Search Widget**
- Upgrade your documentation with AI search capabilities for user inquiries.

**📊 AI-Powered Analytics**
- A new dashboard providing insights into chatbot performance for informed decision-making.

**🏋️‍♂️ Advanced Training Options**
- Utilize advanced training to better educate chatbots with webpage data.

**🧠 Learning from Feedback (RLHF)**
- Improved detection of unresolved queries and capture of negative feedback for enhancements.

**🛡️ Security Update**
- Enhanced security measures for the whitelist domain feature.

**📚 Learning from Previous Chats**
- Expanded self-learning capabilities with integrations for Crisp, Intercom, Discord, and Slack.

## Updates for July 2024

**🤖 GPT4o Mini Model**
- **Overview:** 10x cheaper than the standard GPT4o model, ideal for regular tasks.

**🔍 Web Search:**
- Real-time search functionality.

**🌟 Multi LLM:**
- Options to choose from the latest LLMs, including Anthropic Claude and Mistral.

**🏹 Triggers:**
- Engage users with proactive messages.

**📨 AI Reply:**
- Instant generation of responses for user inquiries.

**📦 New Library Templates:**
- Access and import new templates for immediate use.

**🌐 Create Contact & Leads:**
- Enhanced methods for creating contacts using JS SDK and Studio.

**💬 Queue Reply:**
- Manage customer inquiries effectively with queued responses.

**🎁 New Program:**
- Participate in our rewards initiative for user contributions.

## Updates for June 2024

**🚀 Enhanced AI Tools for Support Teams:**
- **Rewrite:** Easily modify messages for clarity and accuracy.
- **Change Response Tone:** Adjust the tone of responses based on context.
- **Translate:** Implement real-time translation for multilingual communication.

**🤖 Parent-Child Bot Integration**
- Connect Bot A's data with other bots without retraining, streamlining operations.

**🪄 Filters with Views**
- Create customized views for conversations based on segments and integrations.

**🔎 Improved Search Window**
- Enhanced functionality for quickly finding contacts and past conversations.

## Updates for May 2024

**🤖 GPT-4o Availability**
- **Overview:** GPT-4o is now available on our platform.
- **Benefits:**
- ⚡ **Speed:** Two times faster than previous versions.
- 💸 **Cost Efficiency:** 50% cheaper compared to GPT-4 Turbo.

**⚙️ New Discord Settings**
- Customize your Discord experience with new settings available in the integration menu.

**🕒 No Response Timeout (Chatbot Studio)**
- Users can now set a specific wait time for user input. If there's no response within the designated timeframe, a separate path sequence will be triggered, enhancing interactivity.

**📱 New Mobile App is Available:** We're happy to announce the launch of our new mobile app, allowing you to access all features and functionalities on the go!

**🌐 Browser Extension for Chrome and Firefox:** 
- New browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox for quick access for knowledge ai.

**📚 New Training Options and Improvements:** 
- New training options are available to help you better train your chatbots for enhanced performance.

**🔒 Improved Security Features:** 
- We've added new security measures, including a throttling setting to manage user requests and prevent overload.

## Updates for March 2024

**🎤 Voice Messages & Text to Speech:**
- Introduced functionality for sending voice messages and converting text to speech, enhancing user interaction.

**📡 Stream Option Feature:**
- Added a streaming option for real-time engagement and improved communication capabilities.

**🔒 Restrictions Feature:**
- Implemented a new feature allowing users to set restrictions, enhancing control over conversations.

**🔄 Customizable Previous Memory Limit Option:**
- Users can now customize the memory limit for previous interactions, improving the personalization of responses.

**🧠 Customizable AI Chat Memory Options:**
- Enhanced flexibility in managing AI chat memory, allowing for tailored user experiences.

**📚 Crisp Integration:**

## Updates for February 2024

Launch Chatbot Studio aims to improve customer interactions through conversational AI. It provides features for better support, user experiences, and functionality.

**🎯 Events Intent Detection:**
- Control your AI agent's responses with Events Intent Detection. Set up flows based on specific events or message intents for more personalized interactions.

**🔌 Third Party API Integration:**
- Connect chatbots to external APIs for real-time data fetching, allowing your AI agents to provide accurate and timely information.

**💬 Interactive Responses:**
- Use dynamic elements like carousels, cards, and buttons to enhance user engagement during interactions.

**📝 Capture Useful Information:**
- Collect important information during conversations to offer tailored responses and improve user experience.

**💻 Code Execution:**
- Execute complex tasks easily with code execution, expanding the capabilities of your AI agents.

**🔍 AI Task & Segmented Knowledgebase:**
- Improve accuracy by connecting to segmented knowledge bases or performing AI tasks for relevant responses.

**📹 Video Overview:**
- www.youtube.com/embed/V0zIjgcG6yw

Explore the limitless possibilities of conversational AI and start your transformative journey with YourGPT Chatbot Studio! 🌈

**🌪️ GPT-4 Turbo Support:**
- GPT-4 Turbo is the latest advancement following GPT-4, designed to handle large-scale models with remarkable efficiency. It features an extended context size of up to 100K, making it ideal for managing more complex and lengthy interactions.

**🤝 Integration with Messenger, Line, and Telegram:**
- This integration enables seamless interaction with the AI system across popular messaging platforms, enhancing accessibility and user convenience for those needing an omnichannel platform.

**📝 Conversation Detail Improvements:**
- **Navigation Tracking:** Native tracking of conversation metrics for deeper insights into user interactions, including duration, engagement quality, and user satisfaction.
- **New Actions for Conversation Management:**
- **Mark as Resolved:** Quickly mark queries as resolved, streamlining the management process and ensuring timely follow-up.
- **Transfer to Bot/Human:** Seamlessly transition between AI and human support, providing a flexible and efficient support experience.
- **Export Conversation:** Functionality to export conversation transcripts for record-keeping, analysis, or compliance purposes.
